chapters.title: The Thicket
chapters.summary: A dense stretch of thorn and old stone.

events.title: The Fishing Point
events.body: A quiet stretch of water opens between the trees, where dark shapes move beneath the surface, big fish that seem slow and unafraid.

choices.label: Go fishing
choices.body: The bait has barely touched the water when the line goes taut. After a short fight, you pull an eel ashore, still twitching.

events.title: The Overgrown Chapel
events.body: The church stands abandoned in the thicket, vines on the walls and moss on the steps. Thorns climb the cracked facade, the roof sags under green, and the open doors show only shadow and silence inside.

choices.label: Search the main halls
choices.body: The main halls are emptier than you expected. The benches are gone and the altars are bare. At the far end, a single torch still seems to burn, somehow.

choices.label: Take the stairs into the crypt
choices.body:
After a few turns of the stair a great stone door stops you, locked tight.

Beside the door, a socket is cut into the stone, just the size of a tablet or of some key from a forgotten age. Whether such a thing still exists is another question.

choices.label: Set the tablet into the socket
choices.body:
You set the tablet into the socket. The door fights you, then gives, grinding open on its own, slow and unwilling.

Beyond it is an armory, a reminder that even the monks had to defend themselves.
once: Gain items [Simple Boots (8)] [Wooden Shield (9)] [Throwing Spear (6)] [Chain Armor (12)].

events.title: The Open Wood
events.body: The wood here is a little easier going than the rest of the thicket, and far less tangled with thorn bushes. In the distance, a deer slips between the trees and is gone.

choices.label: Search the wood for usable timber
choices.body: You spend some time looking for wood that will actually be of use. There is enough of it here, if you are willing to cut and carry.
choices.info: Materials can be used to upgrade your camp. In this demo, just treat them as quite valuable.

choices.label: Go hunting
choices.body: You follow the signs as best you can. It takes patience, but you finally bring the deer down.

events.info: You cannot rest while exploring a POI. To regain :Energy:, leave the POI, take a rest action, then explore it again.

events.title: The Temple Ruin
events.body: An abandoned ruin sits in the thicket. At first glance it is unremarkable, just a scatter of stone, but if you look longer the shape of an old temple starts to come through. There might still be something left in the rubble.

choices.label: Search the ruins
choices.body: After some searching you find an old stone tablet under a fallen slab. It looks very old.

events.title: The Thorn-Bush Recess
events.body:
The settlement sits in a recess in the mountains, reachable only by a narrow path. They used to close that path with a wall, and the wall is still there in pieces, the stone slumped and the gates long gone.

What remains of the approach is completely overgrown. Thick thorn bushes fill the path from side to side, and there is no way in except through them.

choices.label: Fight your way through the thorn bushes
choices.body: You force your way through the thick thorn bushes. It is exhausting, and you pick up more than a few scratches along the way.
repeatable: Move to the other side of the thorn bushes.

choices.label: These thorn bushes look dry enough to burn…
choices.body:
You set the thorn bushes alight. Heat rolls over the path, and the living wall collapses into ash and embers. When the fire dies, the way to the settlement stands wide open.

You reach the settlement and are greeted by distressed people. “What happened to the thorn bushes? They were our only protection against the terrors outside. Our walls are really not up to date. We need to repair them as soon as we can. Do you know what happened? Could you maybe help us with the repairs?”

choices.label: Offer your help
choices.body: Thanks to your help and the materials you offered, the wall is repaired quite quickly. The settlement is safe again.
once: The way to the settlement is free: Place sticker A. Gain the 'Helper' achievement.
choices.info: Achievements would track how the world remembers you and change future interactions. In this demo, they don't change anything.

choices.label: Pretend you know nothing
choices.body: They eye you with suspicion. “Sure… must be a coincidence, then. You can stay, but if you want a safe night, you’re going to need to hire some guards.”
ongoing: Visiting the inn in this settlement costs each character 5 gold.
once: The way to the settlement is free: Place sticker B. Gain the 'Pyromaniac' achievement.
choices.info: Achievements would track how the world remembers you and change future interactions. In this demo, they don't change anything.

choices.label: Rest at the inn
choices.body: Each character may heal to full HP and remove Critical.

choices.label: Buy and sell items
choices.body: You may buy the following items: [Food (3)] [Throwing Spear (6)] [Refreshing Drink (7)] [Simple Boots (8)] [Wooden Shield (9)] [Cleaving Axe (10)] [Slingshot (11)] [Chain Armor (12)] [Living Armor (13)]

combats.label: I
conclusion: Each character chooses one of their :Card-2: cards and puts it on top of their deck

conclusion.info: At the end of combat, discard your hand. Do not reshuffle the discard pile or the shield pile; both stay as they are for the next combat.

conclusion: Return to the map and continue with the exploration phase.

conclusion: Each character chooses one of their :Card-2: cards and puts it on top of their deck

conclusion.info: At the end of combat, discard your hand. Do not reshuffle the discard pile or the shield pile; both stay as they are for the next combat.

conclusion: Return to the map and continue with the exploration phase.

combats.label: X
conclusion: The Heart of the Thicket, the corrupt forest spirit that had been poisoning the woods from within, finally falls. In the cracked core of the creature you find a pale root still green at the tips. As the corruption fades, the thorn bushes across the region wither and pull back from the paths they once choked.

conclusion.info: The Demo ends here. Otherwise, players would receive a unique item, even stronger cards and a new achievement. The story would continue from a new page of the map book with a 'liberated' Thicket.
